metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the project-onboard plugin. Add this repo as a marketplace, then install the plugin from it.

plugins.name: project-onboard
plugins.description: Project onboarder: scaffolder script + judgment runbook that takes a project to a consistent standard — brand-new, or an existing directory via adopt mode (stale revivals and never-properly-set-up projects: gap-fill only, history immutable, working tree as found). Private GitHub repo (public only on explicit request), pinned per-repo git identity, project CLAUDE.md, serena onboarding (full six-memory set), and a quantitative verification gate.
